reviewer_scope: Independent AI body reading of the following primary passages, plus elementary derivation of the authored finite models. No runtime, material, physical, language-human or learner acceptance.

readings.method: web.open and web.find actual rendered body
readings.passages: Axis order; Introducing transforms; rotations relative to parent versus object space
readings.assessment: Supports separating local and parent transforms and preserving operation order. It does not supply the classroom hinge, sagitta, modular seam or inventory inputs. Those are expressly authored mathematical constructions.

readings.method: web.open and web.find actual rendered body
readings.assessment: Perspective scales apparent size with depth; orthographic size is distance independent. fov applies in perspective and the locked axis determines the interpreted axis. VC014 explicitly pairs vertical FOV and viewport height; no actual Camera3D was configured.

Node material supersedes mesh material, material override supersedes both, and overlay is drawn over the current material. SEM014 correctly distinguishes this resource precedence from its own right-biased partial-map field algebra.

readings.method: web.open and web.find actual rendered body
readings.assessment: The image-chain example halves both dimensions per level. The documented Limit warning says it is unimplemented in this version. VC016 correctly treats total gutter division as an ideal geometric condition, not a complete sampling or bleed guarantee or a report on a fork.

readings.method: web.open and web.find actual rendered body
readings.passages: Setting up visibility range; properties; Fade mode
readings.assessment: Hysteresis margins and visibility ranges use 3D distance relative to AABB center. Disabled uses hysteresis; Self/Dependencies use alpha transitions. FUT011 correctly declines to equate these host settings with authored feasible pixel intervals.

readings.method: web.open and web.find actual rendered body with equations
readings.passages: Linear Thermal Expansion equations 1.1/1.2 and coefficient units/approximation
readings.assessment: Equation1.2 multiplies original length, coefficient and temperature difference. The coefficient is a material property with temperature dependence, so PHY017's constant invented coefficient and free-growth scope are necessary and explicit.

readings.method: web.open and web.find actual rendered body with equations
readings.passages: Center of Mass equations9.29-9.32; calculation procedure
readings.assessment: Position is weighted by component mass divided by total mass; a mass at the origin must remain in the denominator. This supports PHY018's calculation but does not supply actual sculpture masses, strength or stability measurements.
readings.lookup_limit: Initial web.find for mass-weighted returned no match. Follow-up Center of Mass find returned the needed complete definition, coordinates and calculation procedure; no content inferred from the failed search.

readings.passages: Two-level full factorial designs, standard order and analysis matrix interaction columns
readings.assessment: Supports complete level crossing and explicit interactions. PHI011 defines interaction as its own difference of within-lighting mesh contrasts; it does not confuse that definition with a measured randomized experiment.
